payer_identifier_systems.description: A prototype 'rough consensus working code' identifier system that enables healthcare payers in the United States to self-enumerate in support of a National Provider and Payer Directory. Payers generate their own identifiers and publish Payer Well-Known Endpoint Files that map payer and plan identifiers to FHIR endpoints and other interoperability metadata, supporting user-friendly plan discovery and crosswalks between the various payer identifier systems. This is an early exploratory prototype and should not be considered a formal or permanent identification system.

A web-based application used by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS). It acts as a central portal for state entities and private health insurance issuers to submit, collect, and manage plan and issuer data. HIOS Issuer IDs are commonly used to identify ACA Marketplace issuers.
A Medicare Advantage, Part D, Cost Plan, PACE, or other CMS contract number. A unique alphanumeric identifier assigned by CMS to the organization operating the plan.

A historical payer routing identifier from the National Electronic Information Corporation (NEIC), an early healthcare EDI network. Many systems still refer to payer IDs as 'NEIC IDs' even though the organization no longer exists.

A deterministic identifier derived from a payer's legal name, generated as implemented in tools/seed_medicare_advantage/seed.py. The legal name is first normalized by lowercasing it and removing every character that is not a-z or 0-9 (e.g. 'Aetna Health, Inc.' becomes 'aetnahealthinc'). A UUID version 5 is then formed by chaining from the DNS namespace: system_uuid = uuid5(NAMESPACE_DNS, 'PAYER_NAME.fhir'), and the final identifier = uuid5(system_uuid, normalized_legal_name). Payers whose legal names normalize to the same string are treated as the same payer entity and share a single identifier. We expect to retire this identifier, since it will have frequent collisions and is not a standard identifier system.

payer_identifier_systems.acronym: National Council for Prescription Drug Programs
payer_identifier_systems.description: A payer identifier used within NCPDP pharmacy transaction standards. NCPDP identifiers are commonly used in pharmacy claims processing and pharmacy benefit management systems.
